description: This file contains unit tests for the 'strbuf' module, including setup functions, assertions, and individual test cases to verify string buffer initialization, addition of characters and strings, and sanity checks.

methods.name: void setup(void (* f)(struct strbuf *,const void *),const void * data)
methods.description: Wraps test functions to initialize a new empty strbuf, run the test, then release the buffer and verify it's empty.

methods.name: void setup_populated(void (* f)(struct strbuf *,const void *),const char * init_str,const void * data)
methods.description: Wraps test functions to initialize a strbuf with a specific string, run the test, then release the buffer and verify it resets properly.

methods.name: void assert_sane_strbuf(struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Checks that a strbuf has a non-NULL buffer, is null-terminated, and has consistent length and allocation properties.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__static_init(void)
methods.description: Tests that a statically initialized strbuf has correct initial values.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__dynamic_init(void)
methods.description: Tests dynamic initialization and properties of a strbuf.

methods.name: void t_addch(struct strbuf * buf,const void * data)
methods.description: Test helper that adds a character to a strbuf and checks post-conditions.

methods.name: void t_addstr(struct strbuf * buf,const void * data)
methods.description: Test helper that adds a string to a strbuf and verifies the buffer state.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__add_single_char(void)
methods.description: Tests adding a single character to an empty buffer.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__add_empty_char(void)
methods.description: Tests adding an empty character to an empty buffer.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__add_append_char(void)
methods.description: Tests appending a character to a populated buffer.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__add_single_str(void)
methods.description: Tests adding a string to an empty buffer.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__add_append_str(void)
methods.description: Tests appending a string to a populated buffer.

ctags.name: setup_populated
ctags.signature: (void (* f)(struct strbuf *,const void *),const char * init_str,const void * data)
